reconstructionCaveats: The original source fades its bottom rocks into an opaque backdrop. The redraw reconstructs a clean closed rock silhouette and simplifies plants to broad leaf sprays. No landscape extension or extra character is introduced; the figure remains hidden behind foreground cover. Native32 caveat: the cyan eyes are still very small details and are not as readable as at source512; acceptance relies on the clear hood, cover-rock and plant silhouette rather than claiming equal eye detail at both sizes.
